title: Rex v1: the send-off loop
goal: Open a plan in Rex, see its outline and pinned task, watch the agent work it on the tape, mark it done with a retrospective, and type sendoff to get a brief you paste into the next chat. Rex stays watch-only: it never sends, approves, or steers.

in: v1 plan JSON: parse, show, pin, complete
send-off brief generated from the plan file
drift from the pinned task, shown in Rex only
opt-in hooks for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode next to Cursor
out: injecting prompts or plans into the agent
a custom plan language or a web UI

tasks.title: Plans you can read
does: A plan file has a frozen v1 shape and Rex shows it as an outline

tasks.title: Freeze the v1 plan format
does: internal/plan parses v1 and reports problems instead of failing
Create writes an empty v1 stub instead of {}
docs/plan-format.md is the contract
accomplished: internal/plan reads v1 with Problems instead of errors; Create writes an empty v1 stub with O_EXCL; docs/plan-format.md is the contract, tested against the code
verified_how: go test ./... and the pre-PR gate (gofmt, vet for darwin/linux/windows, staticcheck, go test -race, go1.22.12 test)

tasks.title: Edit a plan without disturbing it
needs: internal/jsonedit splices one member and keeps every other byte
does: Status and completion edits touch only the target task's members
A file changed on disk since it was read is re-checked, never clobbered
verify: golden diffs: a pin changes only status values
accomplished: plan.Edit splices only the changed members through jsonedit, re-runs the op if the file changed underneath, checks the expected tree and renames atomically; ~/.rex/state.json holds the last plan per repo and pin starts
verified_how: go test ./... and the pre-PR gate (gofmt, vet for darwin/linux/windows, staticcheck, go test -race, go1.22.12 test)

tasks.title: Outline, plan detail, task detail
does: Opening a plan lands on its outline
External edits reload with a toast; invalid JSON keeps the last good copy
verify: open → outline → task detail → Esc → library in tmux at 78 and 38 columns
accomplished: opening a plan lands on its outline with glyphs, rollups, deps and blurbs; plan and task detail; a 500 ms hash poll reloads outside edits with a toast and keeps the last good copy on bad JSON; Continue card
verified_how: go test ./... and the pre-PR gate (gofmt, vet for darwin/linux/windows, staticcheck, go test -race, go1.22.12 test); tmux at 120x32, 80x24 and 60x20

tasks.title: Pin, complete, send off
does: The pinned task drives completion, the send-off brief, and drift

tasks.title: Pin one task
does: p⏎ pins the selected leaf task; the status line shows it
verify: pinning writes active on the target and pending on the old pin, nothing else
accomplished: p⏎ and pin <id>⏎ write active on the target and pending on other active leaves; a confirm for blocked, waiting or moved pins; reopening keeps the retrospective
verified_how: go test ./... and the pre-PR gate (gofmt, vet for darwin/linux/windows, staticcheck, go test -race, go1.22.12 test); a pin on disk changes only status values (golden test)

tasks.title: Mark the pin done with a retrospective
does: d⏎ opens a completion overlay prefilled from the agent's trailer and the tape, and writes accomplished, modified, verified_how
verify: git diff shows only that task's lines
accomplished: d⏎ opens a form prefilled from the agent's trailer and what Rex saw since the pin; CompleteOp writes done plus only the changed fields
verified_how: go test ./... and the pre-PR gate (gofmt, vet for darwin/linux/windows, staticcheck, go test -race, go1.22.12 test); tmux walkthrough: the retrospective landed on disk

tasks.title: Type sendoff, get a brief
does: s⏎ builds the issue #9 brief from the JSON and shows it to copy
verify: golden brief from a fixture plan
an empty plan says nothing to send
accomplished: s⏎ builds issue #9's brief from the JSON with a Done section, the trailer request and a fingerprint, under 4 KB; b⏎ is the planning brief; o⏎ prints it plain; a pasted brief collapses on the tape
verified_how: go test ./... and the pre-PR gate (gofmt, vet for darwin/linux/windows, staticcheck, go test -race, go1.22.12 test); golden test against issue #9's own example; o⏎ round trip in tmux

tasks.title: Copy the brief honestly
does: The brief is copied with the platform tool or OSC 52, and the view says which
accomplished: pbcopy, clip.exe (UTF-16LE + BOM), wl-copy or xclip/xsel off the UI goroutine, else OSC 52 between frames; the status says copied only when the tool exited 0
verified_how: go test ./... and the pre-PR gate (gofmt, vet for darwin/linux/windows, staticcheck, go test -race, go1.22.12 test); the real pbcopy path on macOS, clipboard restored after

tasks.title: Show drift from the pin
does: Edits and prompts off the pinned task show soft or hard drift in Rex only
verify: nothing is written to the feed, the plan, or stdout
accomplished: CheckEdit and CheckPrompt grade live edits and prompts against the pin (none, soft, hard); row 1 and one tape block per pin; nothing reaches the feed, the plan or the agent
verified_how: go test ./... and the pre-PR gate (gofmt, vet for darwin/linux/windows, staticcheck, go test -race, go1.22.12 test)
